subject: Order items when plotting item characteristic curves for all items in the data

messages.author: bcbedd61f3bec2b0
messages.subject: Order items when plotting item characteristic curves for all items in the data
parts:
Hello,
I'm trying to plot item characteristic curves for 10 items at once. 
I actually manage to do that, but I can't order them from 1 to 10.
Is it possible to do that? 

here is a chunk of my code
bwtheme <- standard.theme("pdf", color=FALSE)
plot(2.pl.fit, type = "trace", 
     which.items = 1:10,
     par.settings = bwtheme, facet_items=TRUE,
     theta_lim = c(-3,3))

These look ordered from 1 to 10 to me, but as per lattice convention the counting starts at the bottom right.

messages.subject: Re: Order items when plotting item characteristic curves for all items in the data
parts:
I probably should have added, if you want the ggplot2 like faceting then use the layout and as.table commands:

library(mirt)
data <- key2binary(SAT12,
                   key = c(1,4,5,2,3,1,2,1,3,1,2,4,2,1,5,3,4,4,1,4,3,3,4,1,3,5,1,3,1,5,4,5))

two.pl.fit <- mirt(data, 1)

which.items = 1:10,
     par.settings = bwtheme, facet_items=TRUE,

theta_lim = c(-3,3), layout = c(4,3), as.table=TRUE)


Phil
